initial_prompt: I'm feeling really overwhelmed today. Work is piling up, I haven't slept well, and I just got some bad news about a family member's health. I don't even know what I'm asking for - I just needed to tell someone.

messages.content: I'm feeling really overwhelmed today. Work is piling up, I haven't slept well, and I just got some bad news about a family member's health. I don't even know what I'm asking for - I just needed to tell someone.

I'm glad you did.

That's a lot to be carrying—any one of those things would be hard, and they're all happening at once. The sleep deprivation alone makes everything feel heavier and harder to sort through.

You don't need to know what you're asking for. Sometimes the need is just to say it out loud (or type it out) to someone who's actually listening. I'm here for that.

If it helps to talk through any of it—the work stuff, the family news, whatever's most present—I'm here. And if you just need to sit with it for a minute, that's okay too. There's no right way to do this.

How are you doing right now, in this moment?
